assignmentMethod: Each full-suite root belongs to exactly one group: a root registered at the top level of a file takes that file's fileGroups entry, and a rootAssignments row (overrides, computed or indented titles) wins over it (#2232). Recorded current-main durations below establish the four-way balance. Roots under 2s remain in core, longer topics are routed to their named scenery, persistence/recovery, or native/process lane, and scripts/agent-tools test files stay native-process. Shared-resource execution is serial. Ticket #267 startup-title renaming is reconciled to its one historical root without duplicating children.

groups.description: Fast application and scanner regression cases, balanced using the measured current-main cohort.
Longer scenery, motion, viewport and rendering contracts.
Longer saved-state, synchronization, storage and recovery contracts.
Longer native/browser/process contracts and scripts/agent-tools checks.
